phrase.zh: 让转变留下痕迹，观察便有了新的入口。
phrase.en: When a transformation leaves a trace, observation gains a new opening.

visual.zh: 近乎俯视的圆形玻璃腔体越出上缘，宽金属外圈围住玻璃边沿；左下小薄片与四道细弧线相接，弧线向腔体上方和右侧散开。
visual.en: A near-top-down circular glass chamber crops beyond the top edge. A broad metal ring surrounds the glass lip; a small foil at lower left meets four fine curved traces spreading upward and to the right within the chamber.

background.zh:
弗雷德里克·约里奥与伊雷娜·约里奥-居里共同获得1935年诺贝尔化学奖，各占一半。1934年，他们用α粒子照射薄铝片，发现停止照射后仍有辐射：部分铝原子已变成磷的放射性同位素，也就是会发生放射性衰变的另一种磷原子。雾室能让粒子留下可观察的轨迹。画面的玻璃容器与细线取意于这种观察，是原创插画，不是原用装置、照片或轨迹数据；短句为原创。
1935年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：因合成新的放射性元素，与伊雷娜·约里奥-居里共同获奖。
background.en:
Frédéric Joliot shared the 1935 Nobel Prize in Chemistry equally with Irène Joliot-Curie. In 1934 they exposed thin aluminum to alpha particles and found that radiation continued after irradiation stopped: some aluminum atoms had become a radioactive isotope of phosphorus, a form of phosphorus that undergoes radioactive decay. A cloud chamber can reveal particle tracks. The glass vessel and fine lines draw on this observation; they are original artwork, not the historical apparatus, a photograph or track data. The phrase is original.
1935 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: in recognition of their synthesis of new radioactive elements
